body: TensorRT LLM provides users with an easy-to-use Python API to define Large Language Models (LLMs) and supports state-of-the-art optimizations to perform inference efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs. TensorRT LLM also contains components to create Python and C++ runtimes that orchestrate the inference execution in a performant way.
plain_description: **Run large language models and visual generation models faster on NVIDIA GPUs.** Optimize inference for your workloads. Customize and extend the system with its Python framework.
technical_description: TensorRT LLM is an open-source library for optimizing LLM and visual generation inference on NVIDIA GPUs. It provides custom kernels for common inference operations, runtime optimizations, and a high-level Python API for single-GPU, multi-GPU, or multi-node deployments. It integrates with NVIDIA Dynamo and Triton Inference Server. Telemetry is collected by default, with opt-out options.
title: TensorRT LLM
